_source: OP (runr-test), 2026-09-30: data of ConfigMap runr-sandbox/kata-runr-config and the pod template annotation runr.dev/kata-config-hash of DaemonSet runr-sandbox/kata-installer, as RunR 0.4.1 installed Kata (clh, qemu, dragonball) on single-node k3s

data.dropin-kata-clh-runr.toml:
# RunR: the whole sandbox (shim, VMM, virtiofsd) runs in the pod cgroup, sized by the
# RuntimeClass overhead; the VM gets the pod limits on top of a small base.
[hypervisor.clh]
default_vcpus = 1
default_memory = 256
reclaim_guest_freed_memory = true

[runtime]
sandbox_cgroup_only = true
static_sandbox_resource_mgmt = true
